mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary tightening, which raises discount rates for equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months with a month-over-month FEDFUNDS increase of at least 0.25 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 4.0% (UNRATE < 4.0) indicates an overheating labor market that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when UNRATE is below 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous month-over-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals broad-based demand weakness, indicating an impending economic slowdown that produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when both HOUST and RSAFS decline month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an imminent economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO declines in a late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.0% (FEDFUNDS > 2.0) indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases the cost of capital and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months with a PAYEMS increase.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals reduced consumer confidence and weak demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when HOUST declines in a high-inflation regime.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates severe economic contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of quarters when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline.
